narrative.headline: Live Japan rental class estimates, distinct shops, and a careful booking handoff.
narrative.value_prop: Resolve pickup and return shops, compare real dated class offers, and inspect Toyota’s one-way surcharge and option policies. Final totals and individual driving eligibility remain explicit until Toyota verifies them.
narrative.auth_narrative: Public read-only HTTP. No API key,account login,browser dependency,or saved cookies.

quickstart.comment: Inspect source option and waiver fees.
Compare dated class estimates in JST.

troubleshoots.symptom: Toyota returns a source error or changed rental dates.
troubleshoots.fix: Choose dates within three months and a return after pickup,then retry using the canonical booking URL in the error.
Open booking handoff and verify all extras,one-way fees and final total on Toyota before payment.

narrative.when_to_use: Use for Toyota Japan rental planning: distinct shops,dated class estimates,one-way fee simulation and official option/document guidance. Recheck live inventory before booking.
anti_triggers: Payment,customer profiles or entering personal documents
Guaranteed vehicle model or final inclusive price
Other rental suppliers or road toll calculations
